meta_state_law_citations_007.answer:
The parties agree to develop mutually a performance pay plan, including a specified amount of program funding, to comply with Florida Statutes.

The Association agrees that it shall not authorize, sanction, condone, or engage in any strike as defined in Florida Statutes.

Pursuant to Section 1012.22(1)(c)4.b., Florida Statutes, both parties agree to review this supplements schedule annually and bargain collaboratively supplements that identify instructional personnel entitled to differentiated pay based upon factors, including, but not limited to, additional responsibilities, school demographics, critical shortage areas, and level of lob performance difficulties.

To qualify as a Teacher Athletic Trainer, a person must possess a professional, temporary, part-time, adjunct, or substitute certificate pursuant to s. 1012.56, and be licensed as required by part XIII of chapter 468.

The team shall perform such functions as prescribed by the board and Florida Statutes.
